scope: One year; 14/18 demo runtime mix rounded down for larger fleets; one common direct pilot excluded. Compare full work ledgers for equal useful outcomes. Routine shared updates are counted per rollout domain, not per service; exception services are counted separately per update. Shared deployment/policy setup is counted once per domain, not again as a generic adoption fee. Workflow hours, update frequency, exceptions, domain counts and qualifying investigations are authored assumptions, not measured or industry averages. OBI investigation credit applies only where baseline visibility is missing. Existing equally useful traces imply zero investigation credit. Existing templates and upstream namespace opt-in belong in the baseline. Prototype development/hardening and additional telemetry/support are excluded unless explicitly entered. No waiting-time, outage-revenue or cash-reduction claim.
